name: EPIC 212310801
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 12.0 solar radii and 1.51 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,117 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 1.51 solar masses and 12.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,229 K at its surface.
